land-rover/series.title: Endless Rain, the Philosophy of Constant Forward Motion, and the National Cuisine of Costa Rica
land-rover/series.author: Sinuhe Xavier
land-rover/series.note: Part 2 of photographer Sinuhe Xavier’s scene report from a Panama-to-Mexico drive in a friend’s 1968 Land Rover Series IIA — mechanical failures, torrential rain and a lot of rice and beans.

grenadier/station-wagon.title: 5 Year Trip in an INEOS Grenadier Across the World towing a Patriot X3 Which We Live In
grenadier/station-wagon.author: Matt P
grenadier/station-wagon.note: A family with two young kids left the Grenadier pub in London in July 2023 in a Trialmaster-spec Grenadier, towing a Patriot X3 camper they live in — through Romania and the Stans and heading east. Why they trusted a new truck for five years: mostly proven components and a five-year global warranty.

land-cruiser/100-series.title: OVR Project LC100: first trail run in our budget Toyota Land Cruiser
land-cruiser/100-series.note: A five-owner 1999 LC100 with nearly 300,000 miles takes on Bailey Canyon in the San Bernardino National Forest on OME rear springs, Tundra wheels, Slee slider steps, a BIO dual swing-out bumper and a hidden Smittybilt winch — plus an honest list of what the mechanic found after purchase.

g-class/w460.title: Mercedes-Benz G-Class travels the world
g-class/w460.author: Brett T. Evans
g-class/w460.note: Gunther Holtorf set out from Germany in 1988 in a 300 GD his wife Christine named ‘Otto’. 26 years, more than 550,000 miles and 215 countries later, the G (still on its original engine) retired to the Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart. The original overlanding G.

land-cruiser/fj40.title: We Drive Five Classic Toyota Land Cruiser Off-Road SUVs
land-cruiser/fj40.author: Aaron Gold
land-cruiser/fj40.note: MotorTrend drives five generations of classic Land Cruisers back to back (FJ40, FJ55, FJ60, FJ80 and 100 Series), borrowed from the Land Cruiser Heritage Museum. The trucks that built the nameplate’s reputation.

land-cruiser/200-series.title: Feature Vehicle :: Staples in Tents' 200-Series Toyota Land Cruiser
land-cruiser/200-series.author: Necota Staples
land-cruiser/200-series.note: A 2016 200 Series built for long-distance travel (suspension, tires, storage, power, recovery and a rooftop tent), shaken down on a loop through Mexico and Baja with the Arctic Ocean next on the list.

land-cruiser/70-series.title: Principles of Overlanding: Building a 70 Series Land Cruiser
land-cruiser/70-series.author: Scott Brady with Paul Marsh
land-cruiser/70-series.note: A podcast conversation (with transcript): why the 70 Series is a top long-distance platform, where it's weak (a narrow track and high center of gravity), and how to prioritize suspension, layout, tires, brakes and recovery without overbuilding.
